plain.li: [hunger] Eating properly again. My body takes each meal as if it doesn't believe there'll be another.
[hunger] The hunger's over, but it left me weak. I tire halfway up the slope.
[hunger,lowtech] Broth, then bread, then a little meat. The old way back from hunger, slowly.
[exposure] My body's had a fright from the weather. It's taking its time to forgive me.
[exposure] The weather nearly had me. I sat by the wall in the sun and couldn't think of anything better to do.
[illness] Over the fever, under the weakness. Every task takes two goes now.
[illness] I'm well, they tell me. My legs haven't heard yet.
[bed] Up and dressed for the first time in days. It took me most of the morning.
[bed] My back aches from the bed. I'd rather it ached from work.
[limb] I dropped the cup twice today. I'll learn. I'm learning.
[limb] There are things I won't do again the way I did them. I'm finding the new ways one at a time.
[surgery] The stitches pull when I laugh, so I'm trying not to. {OTHER_nameDef} says it's healing well.
[surgery,old] An operation at my age. {OTHER_nameDef} did well by me, and I mean to do well by the healing.
[impatient] Weak, and the work's piling up where I can see it. I'm told to leave it. I'm leaving it, mostly.
[patient] Weak, and slow, and in no hurry. The work will be there when I'm ready for it.

warm.li: Still weak. The others have been carrying my share without a word, and I've noticed.
[surgery] I owe {OTHER_nameDef} the stitches and the steady hands. I don't know how to thank a person for that.
[hunger] Everyone's glad to see me eat. I'm glad to be eating with them.

cheerful.li: Wobbly as a new lamb, but upright, which is the main thing.
[bed] Out of that bed at last. I may never lie down again. I'll lie down in an hour.
[exposure] The weather tried its best and here I am. Weak, but here.

gloomy.li: Weak, and the days go on without me. I can hear them going.
[limb] I keep looking at where it was. I don't know when I'll stop.
[hunger] We were that close to starving. I don't want to forget how close.

cold.li: Convalescing. I'll take on light work as the strength comes back.
[exposure] Exposure, recovered from. I'll dress for the weather from now on.
[limb] Adjusting to the loss. Some tasks will have to go to others.

plain.li: Felt well enough this morning to do a proper day. By afternoon my knees were shaking and I had to stop.
I tried to do it all at once. Now I'm back where I started, a few days further from being well.
[impatient] Couldn't bear watching the work go undone. Now I'll be watching it for longer.
[old] I forgot I'm not young and not well. My body reminded me before noon.

warm.li: I wanted to pull my weight. Pulled too much of it. I'll let them carry me a little longer.

cheerful.li: Well, that was a mistake. Back to the blankets, and no complaints. Some complaints.

gloomy.li: I'll never be quite well, will I. Every step forward, two back.

cold.li: A setback from working too early. The rest I skipped is now owed with interest.

plain.li: The weakness has gone at last. I only noticed when I stopped noticing it.
Strong again. The stairs are just stairs now.
My strength's come back all at once, as if it had been waiting somewhere for me.
[lowtech] Strong enough again for the hauling and the hunt. I can feel it in my arms.

warm.li: Well again. I'll make it up to the ones who covered for me, every one of them.

cheerful.li: Back to my old self, and my old self is very glad to see me.

gloomy.li: Strong again, for now. I'll enjoy it while it lasts.

cold.li: Recovered. Capacity is back to what it was.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sat by the bed for a while. We didn't talk about being ill at all, which was the best part.
{OTHER_nameDef} came in, sat down, and told me everything I'd missed. Most of it was gossip.
{OTHER_nameDef} looked in on me today. Just a while, but the day felt shorter after.
[convalescing] {OTHER_nameDef} came to see me and said I looked better. I've decided to believe it.
{OTHER_nameDef} sat with me a while. Neither of us said much, and it was enough.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came to sit with me. There's a kindness in sitting that words don't have.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me. Didn't fuss. Liked that.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came by and made me laugh, which hurt, and was worth it.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came. I'd thought they'd forgotten me in here. They hadn't.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} spent time at my bedside. I'll return the favour when it's needed.

plain.li: One more day of this and I'll be back to it.
My legs are coming back to me, slowly.
[walking] Slow and steady, that's me for now.
[walking] Every step's a bit easier than yesterday's.
[walking,old] Walking like my grandmother did, and glad to.
[child] I'm getting better, I'm just slow.

warm.li: Thank you all for your patience with me.

cheerful.li: Nearly back to full speed, give or take most of it.

gloomy.li: I'm so tired of being tired.

plain.li: [ail:HeadCold] My nose has given up on me.
[ail:StomachBug] Don't come near me, it's catching.
[ail:ChestCold] Every cough starts at my boots.
[ail:HayFever] If one more flower opens I'm moving underground.
[ail:Sunburn] Don't slap my back, whatever you do.
[ail:Blisters] My feet and I aren't speaking.
[ail:InsectBites] I've been eaten alive and they're still hungry.
[ail:SoreHands] My hands want a holiday.
[ail:Splinter] It's in deep, the little devil.
[ail:Toothache] Not the cold water, please, not on this tooth.

warm.li: [everyday] Don't worry about me, I'll mend.
[everyday] Kind of you to ask, I'm getting there.
[everyday] Go on, I'll be fine, you've work to do.
[serious] It helps, having you all near.

cheerful.li: [everyday] I've been better, and I'll be better again.
[everyday] Under the weather, but the weather always changes.
[everyday] A few days of this and I'll be back to annoy you all.
[serious] I'm too stubborn for this to finish me.

gloomy.li: [everyday] Nobody else ever seems to catch anything.
[everyday] I'm always the one who gets it.
[everyday] It's one thing after another with me.
[serious] If I don't get up from this, remember me kindly.

cold.li: [everyday] Ill, it will run its course.
[everyday] A few days, no more, I expect.
[serious] Keep the others away until we know what this is.
